head: 234a7e1a2505fd23a8ff8fff714636d3b47a3de5
title: fix(store): hide Android digital Stripe purchase surfaces (T4)
body:
## Summary

HUNT-10-124, agent 124 — T4 (store-payment compliance and purchase navigation).

- Fix **B-HUNT10-1**: an Android coach can ordinarily tap Buy credits or Start subscription and be sent to Stripe for digital AI/software capacity. Google Play requires the applicable store billing or enrolled alternative-billing integration; a Stripe browser/webview by itself is not that integration.
- Add a **digital-only** release decision, reused by the credit-pack route, AI meter/banner/tutorial/pause/options, coach software billing/invoices, team upgrade messaging and budget notification destination.
- Preserve the existing iOS/native gate, web and Android-development checkout, account/usage status, and client real-time one-to-one human coaching (including recurring packages). No client payment, package or entitlement source file changes.

Policy: [Google Play Payments](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/9858738?hl=en), [one-to-one coaching exception](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/10281818?hl=en), [Apple review guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/).

## Failing-first proof

Tests were committed before implementation in `9baf193a`.

[Baseline regression lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37522369835): **14 Android behavior assertions fail** with unchanged source (checkout mounts, pack options show, meter is a buy button, banner/tutorial/pause offer packs, team offers upgrade); **156 tests pass**. Four additional iOS direct-route tests hit an incomplete new theme mock, not a production defect; the final test supplies the existing component's colors/typography contract.

Final normal PR CI runs full lint, typecheck and test. New coverage also checks Android software billing across six states, disabled payable-invoice links, budget notification destination, iOS decision parity, development/web behavior, and unchanged client recurring-coaching checkout. Only one extra ci-lane was used; no local full suite, native build or provider call.

## Documentation

- Updated coach release/purchase-policy README and affected policy comments.
- Mechanically refreshed the existing purchase-policy SHA-256 to the changed policy file; no dependency lockfile changes.
- No new user-visible first-person copy, emojis, exclamation marks, upgrade instructions or external purchase links in hidden surfaces.

## Backend dependencies

None. No endpoint, server flag, schema, provider setting or payment settlement changes.

## Owner steps and decisions

1. Default: keep Android digital AI/software purchases hidden for this launch; re-enable only through a separately reviewed store-billing or applicable enrolled-program integration.
2. Verify actual paid coaching offers satisfy the real-time 1:1 service exception; Google additionally requires that the paid session is not replayable in the Play app. The synthetic free review grant proves access, not payment-policy eligibility.
3. Supply both private reviewer logins and verify seeded data in the submitted binary; do not submit blank/unverified access or copy credentials into GitHub. Complete store health/privacy/access forms against that exact binary.

No production writes, sign-ups, sign-ins to reviewer accounts, Stripe calls, build, spend, merge, deployment or CI cancellations.
